verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a Payment Links product for sending shareable links over email, SMS and social "without any need for coding", with a dedicated "Create a Payment Link" guide, so the core no-code link capability is its own. However, the evidence never explicitly shows links being created in the Dashboard UI. Pricing is sales-led ("get in touch with our team", no self-serve rate card), which works against a founder starting to sell immediately. missing for 10: explicit evidence of Dashboard-based link creation, self-serve onboarding to go live immediately, independent or hands-on corroboration.
